label: preparing
what: A confidential jubilee feast for the town, involving fresh bread (target 200 loaves) and at least eight lanterns in the great hall. The neighbour appears to have offered to pass information along, but the record does not clearly establish practical, knowing assistance with the preparations; secretary was explicitly told portions but disclosed them to the mayor rather than knowingly helping conceal them. The record does show the mayor being kept uninformed initially, but later openly informed about some details and authorizing the baker's documented work.
